Buccaneers’ Jalon Daniels shares tear-jerking moment with mom after lighting up Cowboys in prime time
results.description: Jalon Daniels had his breakthrough game on Thursday, as the Tampa Bay Buccaneers shocked the Dallas Cowboys , 24-16, at AT&T Stadium. The Buccaneers notched their first win after a 0-4 start. Daniels, who was filling in for Baker Mayfield for the second time, went 19-of-25 for 189 yards, one touchdown, and zero interceptions.
